steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Establish basic project identifiers including the application name 'Modern Calculator' and package path 'com.moderncalculator.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Architecture
steps.description: Establish build configurations inside build.gradle setting up JDK 17, SDK 34 as target and compile levels, and SDK 21 as minimum.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Write AndroidManifest.xml defining the launcher activity, correct package reference, system light theme configuration, and forced portrait orientation.

steps.title: Define Localized Strings
steps.description: Set up standard string resource properties including the core app name string value.

steps.title: Create Number Key Visual Assets
steps.description: Construct stateful touch-responsive ripple drawable background for modern round-corner number keys.

steps.title: Create Operator Key Visual Assets
steps.description: Construct highly noticeable stateful orange ripple drawable background for mathematical operator buttons.

steps.title: Create Action Key Visual Assets
steps.description: Construct stateful grey ripple drawable background for special controls such as All Clear, Delete, and Percent.

steps.title: Design Interactive Layout UI
steps.description: Construct modern dark premium display and nested weighted grids for precise button alignments in the activity_main.xml layout.

steps.title: Implement Core View Controller
steps.description: Construct MainActivity.java mapping click listeners to standard buttons and maintaining execution state variables.

steps.title: Implement Calculation Mechanics
steps.description: Develop parsing logic inside MainActivity.java supporting basic arithmetic operations, decimals, sign change, percentage and backspaces.

steps.title: Establish Output Formatters
steps.description: Integrate safe number representation formats, handling division by zero constraints, extreme overflows, and clean integer displays.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Initiate the build compilation using the default gradle assembleDebug settings.
